fields.title: Read the API
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Supplier API returns items with fields: SKU, name, price, category, barcode, stock. Retrieval method — filter by category and modification date, 50 records per request, 20 requests per minute, no webhooks. Catalog size is 30 thousand items.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/0: How long does it take to export the entire catalog?
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: Which two of three features are possible: "in stock now", "new arrivals this week", "product ingredients"?
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/2: What product limitation stems from the lack of webhooks?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 30 000 / 50 = 600 requests at 20 per minute — 30 minutes. Possible: "in stock" (has stock) and "new arrivals" (has modification date filter). "Ingredients" is impossible — no field, requires negotiation with supplier. Without webhooks, price changes are learned on the next export; with a 30-minute export, updating more often than once an hour is unrealistic, meaning prices can be stale for up to an hour — and this must be decided at the product level.
